title: orchestrator_tick: HEARTBEAT_SECONDS called the train's heartbeat is 480 s; the train beats every 240 s
claim: The comment on orchestrator_tick.HEARTBEAT_SECONDS calls 480 the watcher heartbeat the tick assumes and flags a train beat older than 2x it; merge_train.HEARTBEAT_SECONDS, the train's actual beat interval, is 240, so the stale threshold (960 s) is 4 train beats, not 2.
mechanism: Fails D5-criteria.md C1 (precise: true). Two definitions of one interval disagree; the comment states the 2x rule on the wrong base, so either the comment or the constant is stale.

evidence.contention_note: shared box, finder fan-out running; a count is contention-immune

metric_definition: count of the file's D5 units (text_ledger.py units --dim D5) an executed check of the code contradicts (RESULT false_units_total with --file)
phenomenon_property: A comment describing a constant as another component's interval matches that component's constant at the ref.
seam_rule: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub $HOME/venv-ci/bin/python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D5/s5/m4_ledger.py  # the `false` lines: every D5 unit of the cells whose named path, script, identifier, flag or described constant an executed check contradicts
proposed_fix_scope: Either derive the tick's assumed heartbeat from merge_train.HEARTBEAT_SECONDS (threshold 2x240) or reword the comment to state 960 s as four beats; owner of the monitoring threshold decides.
